description: Don't leave home without your Canvas Travel Portfolio Bag! This Every Day Carry Bag (EDC) is perfect for daily errands or your next adventure. It features ample internal storage, including a 7-card organizational compartment and an ID holder. The large main compartment has hidden map and document holders, while the front pocket securely holds essentials with a hook and loop closure. Comfortably sized at approximately 8.5 inches x 6.25 inches x 2 inches, it can be worn over the shoulder or cross-body with its fully adjustable and detachable shoulder strap. The bag is made of heavyweight, durable cotton canvas with leather and metal accents, ensuring longevity. It's also nylon-lined for added durability while traveling and includes internal pen or pencil holders and two side organizational pockets. The improved leather closure strap keeps the front flap securely in place, while the back belt loop provides additional security and stability during travel. Made from Rothco’s durable heavyweight canvas fabric, this superior material is naturally water-resistant, rugged, and is built for the long haul. No one comes close to Rothco’s collection of ultra-premium canvas bags and packs.
